name: cc-pensador
description: Pensador v2: 12-stage PRD workflow skill and /pensador command for Claude Code. Produces a comprehensive, non-truncated PRD (Strict_PRD_Schema with 17 sections covering product, UI/UX design system, data model, API contracts, security/LGPD/multitenancy, observability and architecture). Stages: EXPLORE (project scan + architecture.md), RESEARCH (two tracks: business benchmark — product archetype, competitor feature inventory, feature tiers; and technical — stack detection, researched CURRENT versions, architecture/design patterns, conventions and discouraged anti-patterns — packaged as a reusable Prompt System), COMPLEXITY (Lite/Completo heuristic), BRAINSTORM_GERAL (parallel domain orchestration with requirements-clarity, Codex and AGY as domain lenses), per-feature isolation under .pensador/<slug>-vN/. Mandatory Code Base Memory (codebase-memory-mcp) exploration and mandatory two-track web research (WebSearch/WebFetch) before PRD/Spec generation — so the PRD reflects both the market baseline and the CURRENT engineering practice of the requested stack instead of patterns frozen at the model's training cutoff —, optional Open Design (od MCP/CLI) integration that parses a design brief into a brand-grade design-system.md when the demand has front-end, plus optional OpenSpec spec mode (PRD vs Spec chosen in INIT). Supports --modo claude|agy|kiro|codex to delegate the workflow's heavy work to an external CLI (Antigravity, Kiro or Codex) while Claude orchestrates via AskUserQuestion. All dialogue routes through AskUserQuestion.
